title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Fantasy Springs Resort Casino, Indio | 2008
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Fantasy Springs Resort Casino in Indio, California, USA, on 1 August 2008.

It was the penultimate show by the tenth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 29 dates between June and August 2008.

Starr had previously performed at the Fantasy Springs Resort Casino on 25 June 2006. He returned there on 12 November 2016.

The tenth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Billy Squier: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Gary Wright: vocals, keyboards
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
